name: Celine Dion
notes: The maximal adult-contemporary power ballad. 60–92 with a half-time feel and the backbeat on 3, so `halfTime` is true and the snare is `halftime_3`; the 102–137 straight uptempo band is named here rather than encoded. The drum sentence is a set of absences and they are what the block encodes: "near-absent in verse 1", "a soft kick on 1 and 3", "a huge reverbed snare on 3 entering at the first chorus", and — the delta that matters most — "timpani and orchestral bass drum used as fills; cymbal swells rather than snare rolls into sections", which is why `snareRollLadder` is off, the hat rolls sit at 0.02, the fill schedule is every 16 bars and the perc block is toms and a crash. Harmony is I–V–vi–IV and vi–IV–I–V with "suspended (sus4) chords on the pre-chorus to delay resolution", hence `susSubstitutionProb` 0.38, the highest in this batch. The melody follows the stated dynamic plan — verse low and quiet, chorus a fifth higher, "note density very low" — and the woodwind/oboe counter-melody answering vocal phrases is the `answer_lick` counter at a low ratio. ⚠ `confidence` is medium because the research rates it high-medium. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are all drum probabilities and `bpm.mode` 74. ⛔ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than `reese_sustain`, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** `reese_sustain` is the only rhythm `bass.rs` reads that holds a note, and it emits one note per chord — TASK-162, still open — so this model measured **259 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds** on it against `bass.rs`'s floor of 500. `mirror_kick` with a high root lock is the roster-wide substitution for a sustained sub (`dmx`, `coolio`, `krs-one`, `mobb-deep` all record the same one), and over a kick that plays a soft 1 and 3 with a `4&` it reads as held at this tempo. The research is *"orchestral double-bass plus a keyboard sub on roots; whole notes, moving only at chord changes"* — the roots are `followRootsProb` 0.94, and `M2` joins `P5` because the entry also documents *"suspended (sus4) chords on the pre-chorus to delay resolution"*, which is what a double bass walks through. ⚠ **INFERRED:** the exact 0.94 and `anticipationProb` 0.14 are lane-conventional, not sourced.
